This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The function 'writeXlsx' in 'src/export/xlsx.ts' handles the export of reports to the XLSX format. Modifying this function to remember the last used export format for a user session would address the issue of reverting back to CSV.
